## Purpose and runtime
OpenDroid is a native Android autonomous-agent app: it accepts chat/voice requests, plans multi-step device tasks, obtains approval where required, executes and verifies them, then replans failures. The Android app module is the operational product; `website/` is a separate static project. Runtime composition is Kotlin/Android, Jetpack Compose, Dagger-Hilt, Room, Android Keystore, WorkManager, foreground/accessibility/notification services, and LiteRT/on-device or remote LLM inference.

## Entry points and composition
Application startup and Compose UI begin at `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/OpenDroidApp.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/MainActivity.kt`; navigation enters the screen/view-model layer through `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/ui/Navigation.kt`. Hilt assembles application dependencies and Room via `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/di/AppModule.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/di/DatabaseModule.kt`. The manifest declares Android component boundaries, including privileged services and permissions: `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`.

## Agent planning and execution
`AgentLoop` is the central control loop: it classifies intent, obtains an LLM plan, coordinates plans, and reacts to outcomes. Planning contracts and safety gates are concentrated in `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/agent/AgentLoop.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/agent/PlanManager.kt`, and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/agent/PlanValidator.kt`. Plans are sequences of typed actions; `ActionSequenceExecutor` runs steps and `ReEvaluationEngine` adapts after failures. Approval policy/risk classification creates the main boundary between model-produced intent and device-side effects.

## Action and device-control boundary
The action layer maps planned schemas to concrete executors, then dispatches across system, communication, media, finance, routine, and other domains. Its primary seams are `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/actions/ActionAutoMapper.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/actions/ActionDispatcher.kt`, and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/actions/base/Action.kt`. UI automation is explicitly isolated in the Android Accessibility Service and per-app automators: `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/accessibility/OpenDroidAccessibilityService.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/accessibility/GenericAppAutomator.kt`, and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/accessibility/AccessibilityNodeTraversal.kt`. This is the critical OS/app integration and verification boundary.

## LLM and model lifecycle
Provider-independent inference is exposed by `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/llm/LLMProvider.kt` and constructed through `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/llm/LLMProviderFactory.kt`. Cloud adapters cover Gemini, Claude, OpenAI-compatible services, Ollama, and others; provider credentials must remain separate from prompts and plans. On-device inference/model acquisition is managed by `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/llm/ModelManager.kt`, with background download in `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/llm/ModelDownloadWorker.kt` and LiteRT compatibility checks in `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/llm/LiteRtCompatibility.kt`.

## State, memory, and security
Room is the durable system-of-record for conversations, plans, memory, routines, models, notifications, and execution history, centered on `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/data/db/OpenDroidDatabase.kt` and repository boundaries such as `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/data/repository/PlanRepository.kt`. The memory subsystem combines working, episodic, semantic, procedural, and knowledge-graph forms via `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/memory/MemoryManager.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/memory/graph/PersonalKnowledgeGraph.kt`. Secrets and sensitive memory use Android Keystore-backed stores, notably `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/security/ProviderCredentialStore.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/security/KeystoreSecretStorage.kt`.

## Background and external integrations
Long-lived operation uses a foreground service, boot receiver, and notification listener: `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/service/OpenDroidService.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/service/BootReceiver.kt`, and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/service/OpenDroidNotificationListener.kt`. Voice input/output is isolated under `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/core/voice/`. Social publishing/analytics is a parallel domain behind platform adapters and scheduled work, rooted at `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/social/core/SocialManager.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/opendroid/ai/social/core/adapter/SocialPlatformAdapter.kt`.
